places.name: 1484 by Puro
places.description: The UAE's highest restaurant, 1,484 m above sea level at the Jais Adventure Peak, with floor-to-ceiling windows, a terrace over the Hajar Mountains and an international all-day menu. Book ahead – a reservation is needed to drive up.

places.name: Jais Sledder
places.hours_text: Tue to Thu 11:00 to 17:00; Fri to Sun 09:00 to 17:00; closed Mondays
places.price_text: AED 50 per ride, AED 120 for three; adult with child AED 65
places.description: Mountain toboggan coaster on a low track winding about 1.8 km down Jebel Jais at up to 40 km/h, with two-seater sleds you brake yourself. Tickets at the lower station by the Jais Welcome Centre; the counter may close up to an hour before the last ride.
